title: Flashcards with spaced repetition
when: The user wants flashcards to study vocabulary or facts, where missed cards return sooner and known cards later.
prompt:
Goal: A study loop that shows only due cards, schedules them by a box system and can be driven fully by keyboard.
Steps:
1. Card { id, front, back, box: 1 to 5, due }; intervals per box 0, 1, 3, 7, 16 days.
2. logic.mjs with now passed in: review(card, good, now) moves up a box or back to 1 and sets due; dueCards(cards, now) sorted by due; stats(cards).
3. Study view: front, a Show answer button with aria-expanded, then Again and Good buttons; Space flips, 1 and 2 answer.
4. Flip with a CSS transform transition; under prefers-reduced-motion swap instantly.
5. Deck editor with labeled front and back fields, edit and delete; bulk import lines "front ; back".
6. Session end: "12 reviewed, 3 to repeat, next due tomorrow" in aria-live; save in localStorage cards.v1 guarded.
7. test.mjs with a fixed now: promotion, reset on Again, due order.
Quality bar:
- Only due cards appear in a session.
- Answers are graded honestly: the back shows before grading.
- Text is large enough to read at arm length.
Pitfalls:
- Using Date.now inside logic, which makes tests flaky.
- Box above 5 or below 1.
- Losing progress mid session.
Verify:
- [ ] Keyboard flips and grades.
- [ ] Reduced motion rule exists.
- [ ] Due dates move forward on Good.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (scheduler), test.mjs.

examples.input: cartoes de estudo para vocabulario de ingles
examples.output: Leitner boxes 1 to 5, Show answer then Again/Good, bulk import "dog ; cachorro"
